chapter.verse: Topa phat un! Ke’n, Topa ka phat ding hi.
Ka hin’ lai teng Topa ka phat ding hi; ka nuntak lai teng ka Pasian tungah phatnate ka sa ding hi.
Huhna hong pia thei lo uliante ahi a, mihing’ tapa ahi zongin muang kei un.
A husan’na a bei ciangin amah lei-ah ciahkik a, tua ni mahin ama ngaihsutnate bei ta hi.
Jakob’ Pasian pen ama huhpa hi-in, ama Topa Pasian, a muangpa in mi lungdam ahi hi.
Amah in van leh lei, tuipi leh tuate sunga omte khempeuh bawl a, a tawntungin thuman hi;
a kinengniam mite’ adingin thumanna semkhia a, gilkialte an a vaak hi. Topa in thongkiate khahkhia hi;
Topa in mittawte, khua musak hi. Topa in, niamsakna a thuak mite sangto sak a, Topa in thuman mite a it hi.
Topa in peemtate kem a, meigong numei leh pa nei lote a huh hi; ahih hangin amah in migilote’ vaihawmna suksiatsak hi.
Zion aw, nangma Pasian Topa in khang tawntungin uk ding hi. Topa phat un!
